title: Choose DriveBoard's look
question: The roll assigned KL Rail Wayfinding. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: KL Rail Wayfinding
options.lineage: Rapid KL LRT/MRT station signage and line maps
options.thesis: Your driving day drawn as a rail line: every widget is a station sign, the next prayer is the next stop.
options.viewport: Phone: a charcoal car-board preview of station-sign widgets on a pale platform-tile ground; below it, plain settings rows with one action colour.
options.risk: Line colours can turn into confetti if every widget shouts; each colour must mean one data type only.

raised.raise: Hierarchy by scale contrast alone: giant tabular numerals, tiny labels, no bold-everything.
A strict state vocabulary: live, stale, missing and needs-permission each get one distinct mark.
On the phone, the one saturated action colour appears only on things you can press.
The editor repacks in whole grid cells; nothing ever sits between cells.

options.label: Surau Prayer Board
options.lineage: the digital jam waktu solat boards in every surau and masjid
options.thesis: The car screen reads like the prayer board you already glance at in every surau.
materials: five-prayer row with the next one lit
options.viewport: Phone: a black board preview where the five prayers run in one row and the next one glows amber; settings below on warm off-white.
options.risk: Prayer owns the whole world, so media and battery feel like guests; also the obvious read for a Muslim driver's dashboard.

options.label: Crouwel Grid
options.thesis: The 12×6 layout grid is the design: numerals and cards built cell by cell on a visible armature.
options.viewport: Phone: the board preview with its grid always visible, a giant grid-built clock, settings set on the same grid.
options.case: Fuses cleanly with the editor (the grid is literally the product) but nothing in it says Malaysia, prayer or this car.
options.risk: Reads as a design exercise rather than your car; a visible grid on the car screen adds noise at a glance.

options.label: Variable Font Specimen
options.thesis: One giant glyph morphing under a slider.
options.viewport: A giant letter with a weight slider.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a type specimen has nothing to do with driving or prayer.
options.risk: A design-nerd costume on a car screen.

options.label: Doujin Event Catalog
options.thesis: Hundreds of stamp-sized cells keyed to a hall map.
options.case: Fuses poorly: far too dense for a glance while driving.
options.kept: Whole-cell repacking on the editor grid.

options.label: Acetate Tab Manual
options.thesis: Acetate leaves hinged over coloured divider boards.
options.viewport: An open manual with a stepped tab rail.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a reading artifact, not a glance surface.

options.label: Warm Consumer App
options.thesis: Soft cards on a warm ground with one action colour.
options.viewport: A single column of soft cards.
options.case: Fuses blandly: clear, but could be any app.
options.kept: One saturated colour reserved for things you can press.

options.label: Cassette J-Card
options.thesis: Side A / side B tracklists in ballpoint.
options.case: Fuses poorly: only the media widget fits.
options.risk: Handwriting is illegible at a glance.
options.kept: Times right-aligned tight in a tabular column.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Material 3 dark car dashboard, done properly.
canonCard.viewport: Phone: Material top bar, a rounded dark board preview, Material list settings.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every Android Auto widget app, AutoDeck included.
